description.value: Slo Coffee is a neighbourhood café anchored in Vancouver's Fraserhood community, built around the philosophy of slowing down and savouring the moment over specialty coffee. The menu includes food items such as bacon sandos, vegan spreads, toasts, and overnight oats alongside pour-over and espresso drinks. A second downtown location at Pacific Centre opened in December 2025, expanding the brand's footprint in the city.
